steps.heading: Begin with the outline
steps.caption: Protect your table. Follow the printed lines; use thin coats. Rinse and blot brushes between colors.

steps.heading: Brush in the teal sky
steps.caption: Mix teal with a little white. Paint around the printed shapes with short strokes.

steps.heading: Ground & branches
steps.caption: Paint branches and stems brown. Mix green with a little brown for the ground; leave leaves white.

steps.heading: Fill the curling hat
steps.caption: Mix red with a little brown for rust. Paint thin curved strokes that follow the folds.

steps.heading: Sleeves & leather
steps.caption: Mix green with a little brown for sleeves. Paint boots brown; add a speck of black along lower edges.

steps.heading: Lay in autumn color
steps.caption: Mix orange with a touch of brown for pumpkins and the maple leaf. Alternate orange and yellow on other leaves.

steps.heading: Skin & soft beard
steps.caption: For peach, mix white, a little yellow and a tiny touch of red. Paint nose and hands. Mix white with a touch of yellow for the beard.

steps.heading: Light the lanterns
steps.caption: Paint frames black with a little brown. Use yellow inside; add white to yellow for the flame and soft glow.

steps.heading: Shape the hat
steps.caption: Mix red, brown and a speck of black for fold shadows. Mix red with a little yellow for highlights. Blend along curves.

steps.heading: Round the pumpkins
steps.caption: Mix orange with brown for groove shadows. Mix orange with a little yellow for highlights; follow the ribs.

steps.heading: Pull fine beard strands
steps.caption: Mix white, a touch of teal and a speck of brown for shadows. Pull strokes toward the tips; add white and a little yellow highlights.

steps.heading: Dry & clean up
steps.caption: Let the canvas dry flat. Wash and reshape brushes, wipe the palette and close paint pots.
